outcome: Total amount of opioids prescribed after surgery (measured in morphine milligram equivalents)
cohort: Pediatric patients (aged 0-21 years) who underwent surgical procedures between December 1, 2020, and November 30, 2021, identified from the Merative MarketScan Commercial and Multi-State Medicaid Databases.
finding: Pediatric surgical opioid prescribing is concentrated among a small number of procedures, with tonsillectomy and/or adenoidectomy being the highest prescriber in both age groups studied.
